get_info(IExpr.IKeyword) - Method in class org.smtlib.solvers.Solver_z3_recent
z3 reports a query stopped by its per-query time limit, -t:, with :reason-unknown "canceled" in incremental mode (after a push; checked with z3 4.16.0 and 5.1.0, while 4.8.12 and 4.12.6 give up first, as incomplete), and in every mode in 4.6 and 4.7; one-shot queries in newer versions, and other solvers such as cvc5, report "timeout".

Alt-Ergo ignores get-option, writing nothing; answered from the values set (see set_option_impl) and the SMT-LIB defaults
get_option(IExpr.IKeyword) - Method in class org.smtlib.solvers.Solver_bitwuzla
Answered entirely client-side (never forwarded -- see class comment point 1): from whatever this run has set via Solver_bitwuzla.set_option_impl(org.smtlib.IExpr.IKeyword, org.smtlib.IAttributeValue), falling back to the standard SMT-LIB default for any option never set, and "unsupported" for anything not a recognized standard option at all (matching what a compliant solver would say about an option it doesn't have).
get_option(IExpr.IKeyword) - Method in class org.smtlib.solvers.Solver_cvc5
See the class Javadoc: wraps a bare-symbol answer for a string-typed option (Utils.stringOptions -- currently just :regular-output-channel and :diagnostic-output-channel) into a proper SMT-LIB string literal with the same text, working around cvc5 answering those two with an unquoted symbol instead.
get_option(IExpr.IKeyword) - Method in class org.smtlib.solvers.Solver_simplify
Simplify has no get-option; answered from the values kept by set_option

get_option(IExpr.IKeyword) - Method in class org.smtlib.solvers.Solver_z3_4_3
Sent to the solver, except where z3 4.3's answer does not conform: it defaults :produce-models to true (SMT-LIB: false), writes the channel names unquoted, knows :produce-assertions only as :interactive-mode (see set_option_impl), and answers unsupported, not the default value, for a standard option it lacks
